{"reasoning_steps":["The figure shows a central square connected to eight outer squares arranged around it in a circle.","There are four straight diameters through the center, each passing through two opposite outer squares and the center square.","Each diameter therefore contains exactly three positions whose numbers must sum to 24.","The nine numbers must be strictly positive consecutive integers, so they are {n,n+1,...,n+8}.","Summing the four diameter equations counts the center number four times and each outer number once, giving 4·center + (sum of 8 outers) = 96.","The total sum of all nine numbers equals (sum of 8 outers) + center = 96 - 3·center.","Maximizing the total sum is equivalent to minimizing the center value among the nine consecutive integers.","The smallest possible center in the set is n, which makes the set {n,...,n+8} and allows total sum 9n+36.","Using 9n+36 = 96 - 3n gives n = 5 and center = 5.","With n=5, the numbers are 5 through 13 and each opposite outer pair must sum to 19 to make 24 with center 5.","The outer numbers {6,7,8,9,10,11,12,13} can be paired as (6,13),(7,12),(8,11),(9,10), each summing to 19.","The total sum is 5+6+7+8+9+10+11+12+13 = 81."],"answer":"81"}
